R-hierarchy.reason: The week's lead Shakshuka photo dominates the discover screen, and the detail leads with the photo, the title, and one Save recipe button as the clear primary action.

R-fill.reason: The only strong saturated fill is the Save recipe button; the search bar, selected chip, and ingredients card are soft tonal containers.

R-surfaces.reason: Calm warm-neutral backgrounds with light tonal containers (search bar, ingredients card) group the content without competing with the photos.

R-controls.reason: Chips, the search bar, the filled Save button, and the photo tiles and list rows all read as separate tappable controls; no lone text buttons.

R-font.reason: Fraunces is used for 'Simmer' and the recipe titles at a regular weight with no axis settings, so the brand face shows no deliberate weight or width choice.

R-platform.reason: No chevrons on rows, no Cancel/Done text in a top bar, and content runs edge to edge in Android style.

R-text.reason: No text is clipped or overlapping in any layout; tile titles wrap cleanly and rows cut at the bottom edge are only scrolling content.

R-dark.reason: In dark, text, icons, the stars, the chip outlines, and the light-pink Save button all stay legible on dark surfaces.

R-adaptive.reason: Foldable widens to a roomier single pane, while tablet and desktop show discover beside a two-column recipe detail (ingredients and steps beside the photo), revealing far more at once.

R-idea.reason: A cookbook-spread design: an editorial lead photo with three tiles under it, a serif brand voice, and a detail laid out like a magazine page with photo and title beside ingredients and steps.

R-semantics.reason: Every section title (Simmer, This week, the category count, Ingredients, Steps, recipe name) has heading(); there are no toggling rows, and the category FilterChips are already single controls.

R-fields.reason: The search InputField uses textFieldState from rememberTextFieldState with a searchBarState; there are no password fields.

R-visibility.reason: Nothing is hidden by alpha; category filtering removes items from the list, and the detail swaps through listDetail.

R-blur.reason: No blur is used, and no text is drawn over photos.

R-recipes-browse.reason: Search is a SearchBar at the top, categories are FilterChips, and the featured set leads with a large photo plus photo tiles (a hero-style layout); titles sit below the photos, so they stay readable.
